canberra-61.name: Molonglo Gorge Nature Reserve
canberra-61.bio: Day-use reserve protecting the Molonglo River gorge, with a picnic area, playground and the Blue Tiles walk along the river.
canberra-61.coordinates_source: OSM leisure=playground 'Molonglo George Nature Reserve (South)' in the Molonglo Gorge recreation area (resolve-pin MEDIUM); 0 m from the recreation area, 466 m from the OSM reserve centroid (not used) and 1.2 km from the Wikivoyage listing tag (placement point -35.328093,149.261864), moved 1.2 km
canberra-61.notes: Wikivoyage Airport and East: day use only, free toilets, electric barbecues, picnic shelters and climbing playground at the main recreation area; free; Blue Tiles Walk 6.4 km return. Parks ACT (search summary, page blocked): 506 ha, walking track about 3 km upstream to Blue Tiles. Cost: no entry fee (Wikivoyage 'Free'). Hours 'daylight' derived from 'day-use only'; no hours range sourced.

canberra-62.name: Glenburn Homestead
canberra-62.bio: Heritage precinct in Kowen Forest with ruins, gravesites and farm machinery, and three self-guided loop trails.
canberra-62.coordinates_source: OSM historic=ruins 'Glenburn homestead' (resolve-pin MEDIUM), 21 m from the placement point
canberra-62.notes: Wikivoyage Airport and East: open 24 hours, closed on Total Fire Ban days, no toilets/water/bins, three signposted loop trails, free. Heritage-registered 2015. An undated CityNews item says walkers and cyclists enter through a locked gate at Charcoal Kiln Road/Kings Highway because the site is inside a commercial pine forest, so check access before visiting.
canberra-62.ticket_note: No Glenburn page found; the Parks ACT Kowen Forest page (https://www.parks.act.gov.au/find-a-nature-park/plantations/kowen-forest) does not mention it. Orchestrator to check in a browser for a Glenburn or Friends of Glenburn page; omit otherwise.

canberra-63.name: One Tree Hill Lookout
canberra-63.bio: Hill north of Hall reached by a one-hour uphill walk on the Canberra Centenary Trail, with views over Canberra.
canberra-63.coordinates_source: OSM natural=peak 'One Tree Hill' (resolve-pin MEDIUM), 4 m from the placement point
canberra-63.notes: Wikivoyage Hall: bushwalk of about an hour one-way via the Canberra Centenary Trail from Hoskins and Hall Streets, small car park beside the trail. VisitCanberra Hall page: 'popular section of the Centenary Trail' to the lookout. No fee or hours stated: open-access hill, hours unverified. Visit time is round trip.
canberra-63.ticket_note: No single steward page found; the Parks ACT Canberra Centenary Trail page is a candidate but is blocked and covers the whole trail.

canberra-64.name: Goorooyarroo Nature Reserve
canberra-64.bio: Woodland nature reserve beside Mulligans Flat in Gungahlin, with walking tracks and picnic areas.
canberra-64.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=information node beside an OSM amenity=parking way on the reserve's southern edge, inside the OSM reserve relation 6092536 (bbox -35.213..-35.171, 149.168..149.201); not the centroid (-35.1917,149.1828). Not a resolve-pin result (it returned only the centroid), so MEDIUM at best: 'pin': 'MEDIUM-manual', confirm the entrance on Parks ACT's map
canberra-64.notes: Parks ACT lead list only (page blocked): woodland reserve with walking tracks and picnic areas, adjoining Mulligans Flat. Hours and cost not read: nature reserves in the ACT charge no entry (brief). Overpass was unavailable so the car park choice came from one earlier query.

canberra-65.name: Jerrabomberra West Grasslands
canberra-65.bio: Canberra Nature Park grassland reserve with an 8 km return Grassy Plains walk from the Callum Brae car park.
canberra-65.coordinates_source: LOW: OSM leisure=nature_reserve centroid of Jerrabomberra West Grasslands Nature Reserve (resolve-pin MEDIUM, but a centroid, not a visitor point; midpoint of the Grassy Plains walk not in OSM found). Needs the Callum Brae car park or the walk's midpoint from the Parks ACT map
canberra-65.notes: Parks ACT lead list only (page blocked): 8 km return Grassy Plains walk from the Callum Brae car park, about three hours. 'Callum Brae' Wikipedia title is a New Zealand suburb, not this place. Hours/cost unread: ACT reserves charge no entry (brief); hours unverified; access via Callum Brae noted as limited by the judge.

canberra-66.name: Oakey Hill
canberra-66.bio: Weston Creek hill with easy walking tracks to a 684 m summit, views to the Brindabellas and kangaroos at dusk.
canberra-66.coordinates_source: Wikipedia 'Oakey Hill' article coordinates (the hill itself, 5 decimals), corroborated 190 m away by the Wikivoyage Woden listing tag (-35.339231,149.068114, Heysen Street); the OSM result was only a natural=grassland reserve centroid 329 m away (not used). MEDIUM
canberra-66.notes: Wikipedia: 684 m highest point marked by a survey station, rises 80 m above Lyons, Curtin and Weston, walking tracks generally easy with short steep climbs, views to Red Hill, Mount Ainslie and the Brindabellas. Wikivoyage Woden: open 24 hours, free, reliable place to see eastern grey kangaroos at dusk. The Wikivoyage entry is marked dead link and no Parks ACT page was found.
canberra-66.ticket_note: No Parks ACT page for Oakey Hill found by search; orchestrator to look in a browser (parks.act.gov.au blocks scripts).

canberra-67.name: Mount Wanniassa
canberra-67.bio: 809 m peak in Wanniassa Hills Nature Reserve with trails on both slopes and views over Woden and Tuggeranong.
canberra-67.coordinates_source: OSM natural=peak 'Mount Wanniassa' (resolve-pin MEDIUM), 474 m from the Wikipedia/placement point (-35.3895,149.1197)
canberra-67.notes: Wikivoyage Tuggeranong: 809 m, climbed via established walking trails on east and west slopes, views of Woden and Tuggeranong. Parks ACT Wanniassa Hills Nature Reserve (search summary): 262 ha, ridgetop views of southern Canberra, dogs on-leash on tracks. Hours and cost unread (page blocked); no entry fee for ACT reserves (brief).

canberra-68.name: Tuggeranong Hill
canberra-68.bio: Steep track to a summit with views over the Lanyon Valley and the rest of southern Canberra.
canberra-68.coordinates_source: OSM natural=peak 'Tuggeranong Hill' (resolve-pin MEDIUM), 21 m from the placement point
canberra-68.notes: Wikipedia: part of Canberra Nature Park, a walk to the top gives views of Lanyon Valley and southern Canberra; broadcast translator on top with a service track. Parks ACT (search summary): 365 ha reserve, steep track to the summit; a south-eastern section and part of Rob Roy Range are on leased land and closed to the public. Hours, cost and walk length not sourced; no entry fee for ACT reserves (brief). Visit time is an editorial estimate.

canberra-69.name: Gibraltar Peak
canberra-69.bio: Steep 8.2 km return climb in Tidbinbilla Nature Reserve to a summit with views over Canberra and the reserve.
canberra-69.coordinates_source: OSM natural=peak 'Gibraltar Peak' (resolve-pin HIGH, agrees with 19 geotagged Commons files), 104 m from the placement point. Summit rather than route midpoint: the peak is the spot
canberra-69.notes: VisitCanberra: 8.2 km walk, moderate to hard, about three to four hours return, from Dalsetta via Eliza Saddle; Wikivoyage and Wikipedia: 8.2 km, 2 to 3 hours. VisitCanberra notes the Tidbinbilla Visitor Centre was closed with the reserve open as normal. Reserve gate hours and any entry fee not sourced (tidbinbilla.act.gov.au blocked): free assumed, unverified. Hours 'Daylight hours' is generic for a bushwalk.
